summary:
v0.2.1 hardens the local server and the MCP panel, shrinks the build, and refines the Cyber HUD. It also catches up on everything new since v0.1.1 that the first v0.2.0 notes left out.

## Security

- **Cross-site requests refused** for the endpoints that cost money or write logs (OpenAI realtime and HUD summary, Google Places, the voice debug log), and the dev and preview servers send one full Content-Security-Policy.
- **Cost-bearing proxies throttled by default**: 30 requests a minute for OpenAI and 120 for Google per client, the caps Pinokio already ships. `0` opts out, and an unreadable value falls back to the default instead of unlimited.
- **Host checks everywhere**: the Host check now runs before the app's own routes (they used to answer any Host, including DNS-rebinding names), and binding to all interfaces keeps the check, accepting IP addresses, `localhost` and the LAN names you list.
- **The MCP server and panel**: the panel's requests need a key from its own page and refuse settings, credential and model routes in any spelling; panels share six requests in flight; `/mcp` applies the same proxy and origin checks as Provider Settings and times out request bodies; embed mode can no longer be framed unless you allow the framing page. [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view/blob/main/SECURITY.md) describes the MCP surface.
- The voice debug log keeps the server's own timestamps, and responses send `nosniff`.

**Behavior change:** hostnames ending in `.local` are no longer accepted by default; add them to `GEV_ALLOWED_HOSTS`. A God's Eye View panel opened before updating needs a reload.

## Other changes

- **A smaller build**: each bundled data pack ships once, taking `dist/` from 54 MB to 42 MB.
- **Cyber HUD**: rails no longer crowd the coordinates and attribution, Voice and pin interactions are no longer clipped, and the visual preset you picked is restored when you leave Cyber.

## Also new since v0.1.1

The first v0.2.0 notes missed much of what shipped; they are now [complete](https://github.com/bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view/releases/tag/v0.2.0). The highlights:

- **Recent Imagery**: the last 30 days of keyless NASA imagery for any box or view, compared **A/B** between two days or against the basemap, with the best day **draped automatically** on the globe.
- **Draw and Directions**: draw areas, lines and pins on the world, and get keyless drive, walk or bike routes with turn-by-turn steps you can **fly** step by step. Tilt Map and North Up keep a tracked target centred.
- **Thousands more cameras**: about 3,400 CCTV cameras by default across Ontario, Finland, British Columbia, Texas, Estonia, Warendorf, Sydney/NSW and Calgary, with **live video** for Delaware's statewide cameras, and a **Mapped ALPR Cameras** layer for the US and Canada.
- **Transit and local receivers**: live buses, trains and ferries in seven regions, and a USB RTL-SDR for FM and ADS-B right in the browser.
- **Weather and fires**: radar, infrared clouds, lightning, cyclone tracks, global wind, and Fire Perimeters.
- **Your agent**: God's Eye View in Claude, Codex and ChatGPT ([setup](https://github.com/bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view/blob/main/docs/MCP_SETUP.md)).

## Community

Thank you to the people behind this release's fixes:

- @jasas1 — blocked cross-site requests to the cost-bearing and log endpoints and shipped the Content-Security-Policy (#900, from #242)
- @daikaginza — default throttles on the cost-bearing proxies (#900, from #683)
- @puspoaditya — kept the Host check when binding to all interfaces (#900, from #97)
- @Sunil56224972 — found the overwritable debug-log timestamps and the missing nosniff header (#900, from #710)
- @manjunath22466 — the Cyber HUD layout and preset restoration fixes (#873)

Everyone who contributed to v0.2.0 is credited, with what they built, in the [v0.2.0 notes](https://github.com/bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view/releases/tag/v0.2.0).

## Verification

- Node 24.14, Node 26.x and Windows onboarding CI passed.
- Unit suite: 5,601 passed, 0 failed, 1 intentional skip.
- Production build passed.
- Tracking regression: 109 passed, 0 failed.

Existing Pinokio installs can choose **Update**; terminal installs can run `git pull`.

[Compare v0.2.0...v0.2.1](https://github.com/bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view/compare/v0.2.0...v0.2.1)

summary:
v0.2.0 brings God's Eye View to your agent: ask Claude, Codex or ChatGPT to show a place, and the live globe opens right in the conversation. It also adds Recent Imagery, drawing and directions, transit, local radio receivers, live weather, thousands more cameras and much more.

## God's Eye View through your agent

- **MCP server and shared tool catalog.** About 40 tools — aircraft, ships, satellites, earthquakes, fires and fire perimeters, launches, CCTV and ALPR cameras, radio, places, routing, transit, traffic, weather, wind, cyclones, recent imagery, infrastructure, military awareness and situation briefs — defined once and used by MCP clients and by voice.
- **The live globe in the conversation.** In Claude Desktop and the Codex and ChatGPT desktop apps, answers open as an interactive God's Eye View panel at the right place, with the right layers and style, following an aircraft or riding in its cockpit. Every answer also carries a link that opens the full app there.
- **Works locally, with no HTTPS or tunnel.** The panel loads through the MCP server itself. Setup takes a minute: [docs/MCP_SETUP.md](https://github.com/bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view/blob/main/docs/MCP_SETUP.md).
- **Embed mode.** `?embed=1` shows the globe alone for pages that frame the app.

## Imagery

- **Recent Imagery** (DATA ▸ Recent Imagery). Select a box, use the current view or drop a pin, and get the last 30 days of keyless NASA imagery — HLS Sentinel-2/Landsat at 30 m and optional VIIRS at 250 m — with thumbnails and cloud cover. Compare in **A/B** mode (swipe between two days) or against the basemap, with one-tap swap. The recommended day **drapes automatically** onto the globe, switching from Google 3D to Esri and back when you clear it. PNG export, and share links keep your box, days and comparison.
- Keyless terrain now retries when throttled, drawn shapes drape on keyless terrain, and camera arrivals no longer land underground.

## Draw, route and navigate

- **Draw on the world** (DISPLAY ▸ Draw): areas, lines and pins with labels and colours, draped on the terrain.
- **Directions** (Utilities): set A and B on the globe for keyless drive, walk or bike routes with turn-by-turn steps, then **FLY** the route step by step.
- **Tilt Map and North Up** controls that keep a tracked target centred.
- **Keyless place search** everywhere, with typed coordinates and bundled city names resolving instantly.

## Cameras

- **Thousands more CCTV cameras** — about 3,400 by default, up from about 800 — with new packs for Ontario, Finland, British Columbia, Texas (Austin, San Antonio and district packs), Estonia, Warendorf, Sydney/NSW and Calgary.
- **Live video** for Delaware's statewide DelDOT cameras, with one decoder shared by the camera panel and the 3D projection.
- Guessed camera headings now read **ESTIMATED**, and camera monitors no longer clip into terrain.
- **Mapped ALPR Cameras**: OpenStreetMap locations of license plate readers in the US and Canada, with bearing wedges and SHOW NEAREST. Locations only, never footage or plates.

## Movement and receivers

- **Transit**: keyless live buses, trams, subways, trains and ferries in Boston, Austin, Minneapolis–St Paul, Helsinki, the Netherlands, Norway and South East Queensland.
- **Local RTL-SDR and Local ADS-B**: a USB radio in Chrome or Edge for FM and 1090 MHz aircraft, plus local dump1090, readsb or 978 MHz UAT feeds ([docs/LOCAL-RECEIVERS.md](https://github.com/bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view/blob/main/docs/LOCAL-RECEIVERS.md)).
- More precise satellite pass times with visibility, honest PARTIAL and unknown-speed ship states, and military aircraft kept through feed rate limits.

## Weather, fires and environment

- **Weather**: keyless NOAA rain radar, infrared satellite clouds and lightning on one observed-history timeline; NHC/CPHC cyclone advisories with forecast tracks and cones; GFS and ECMWF wind with temperature and pressure; weather draped on Google 3D Tiles.
- **Fire Perimeters** from NIFC WFIGS with InciWeb links, and MODIS added to Active Fires.
- **Street Traffic** roads from TomTom, OpenFreeMap or both, with first dots in a few seconds; public Overpass is no longer used by default.
- Infrastructure layers (datacenters, dams, cables and installations) are lighter on screen, release memory when off, and gain bundled country, region, county and military-name packs.

## Scenes, HUD and voice

- **Nepal Flood Incident** scene with 25 shots, witness media and before/after imagery; Director gains camera anchors and moves, data packs, feature actions, import previews and sharing.
- **Cyber HUD** theme with GPU contact sonar; Data Layers regrouped into Movement, Cameras, Infrastructure, Events and Utilities; key-gated layers name the key they need.
- Voice controls the new layers, resolves radio by country name, and handles region questions again.

## Platform, setup and security

- Renders on **iPad and iPhone**; trackpad pinch-zoom on macOS; keyboard and screen-reader improvements.
- Setup: one Google Maps entry, a server-only Google key, Pinokio Update shows incoming changes, and key saving fixed on macOS and Windows.
- Hardening across camera media, track and bikeshare proxies, error messages, the voice debug log, dotenv files and pinned CI actions.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for the full list.

summary:
## 🌟 Summary
**v8.4.172 makes oriented-box cropping work as expected and improves reliability across model training, export, dataset handling, and deployment.**

## 📊 Key Changes
- **Rotation-aligned OBB crops:** `save_crop=True` and `ObjectCropper` now save crops upright and aligned to each oriented bounding box. Areas extending beyond the image are filled with black.
- **Model correctness fixes:** AIFI positional embeddings now match non-square feature maps, and RT-DETR computes matching costs in float32 to avoid AMP precision errors affecting training assignments.
- **More reliable training and resume:** NaN recovery now correctly restarts the recovered epoch, while resumed runs preserve the selected optimizer and early-stopping progress.
- **Improved dataset and export handling:** Corrupted dataset caches trigger a rescan; classification datasets recognize more supported image formats; and static INT8 exports can calibrate even when the dataset is smaller than the requested batch.
- **Broader Python support:** Python 3.14 is added to package support and several Docker and export environments. The Python export image remains on Python 3.13 for dependencies that do not yet support 3.14.
- **Platform documentation refreshed:** Docs now describe current Platform behavior and APIs, including Agents management, dataset version comparisons, and direct LabelMe imports.

## 🎯 Purpose & Impact
- OBB users can now get useful, tightly aligned crops instead of no crops or axis-aligned approximations.
- Training and validation should be more dependable, particularly when using AMP, recovering from NaNs, or resuming an interrupted run.
- Dataset and export workflows are more resilient to damaged caches, varied image formats, and small calibration datasets.
- Updated Python support and clearer Platform documentation make it easier to choose compatible environments and follow current workflows.

## What's Changed
* Fix NaN conv outputs in JetPack5 Docker image from OpenBLAS 0.3.8 by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26473
* Bump Prettier from 3.8.5 to 3.9.9 by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26472
* Remove `cloudpickle` and `filelock` base dependencies and disallow new ones by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26471
* Remove redundant Lost-state checks in ByteTrack and FastTracker second association by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26481
* Use pre-cached assets in COCO-eval and CLI solutions tests by @JaviChulvi in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26476
* Align validation, Edge TPU export, and Platform dataset, Agents API, and billing docs with current behavior by @raimbekovm in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26467
* Fix AIFI position embedding for non-square feature maps by @ArgoHA in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26483
* Align Ultralytics Platform docs with current Platform behavior by @pderrenger in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26485
* Move AMD doc to Deployment Integrations by @lakshanthad in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26489
* Name LabelMe and Labelbox in Platform import format lists and correct Label Studio OBB and VOC notes by @raimbekovm in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26488
* Use >= floors in example requirements to stop Dependabot pin bumps by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26501
* Restore the shared CI asset cache in Docker tests and keep it out of images by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26502
* Fix corrupt dataset caches, NaN recovery, YOLOE predict state and batching, RT-DETR save_txt, and tracker/cfg/solution bugs by @cainiao33 in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26477
* Fix RT-DETR Hungarian matching precision under AMP by @Nikhi00718 in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26475
* Restore the optimizer=auto choice and early stopping state on resume by @raimbekovm in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26487
* Replace outputs from previous predict and val runs and give each video its own output name by @raimbekovm in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26494
* Fix integer crop coordinates and JPEG output collisions by @Vaishnavi220506 in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26474
* Upgrade CPU containers and isolated exports to newer Python versions by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26510
* Load every supported image format in classification datasets and refresh stale disk cache by @raimbekovm in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26497
* Fix OpenVINO INT8 calibration for undersized datasets by @JaviChulvi in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26507
* Fix yolo_bbox2segment background-first detection and rerun duplicates, and accept jpeg and uppercase masks by @wizzseen in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26508
* Add rotation-aligned OBB crops to save_crop by @Nikhi00718 in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26486

## New Contributors
